v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Post tríduum * invenérunt Iesum in templo sedéntem in médio doctórum, audiéntem illos, et interrogántem eos.
text.en: After three days, * they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, hearing them, and asking them questions.

text.la: Dixit mater Iesu * ad illum: Fili, quid fecísti nobis sic? Ecce pater tuus et ego doléntes quærebámus te.
text.en: The mother of Jesus said * to him: Son, why hast thou done so to us? Behold thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

text.la: Descéndit Iesus * cum eis, et venit Názareth, et erat súbditus illis.
text.en: Jesus went down * with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them.

text.la: Et Iesus proficiébat * sapiéntia, et ætáte, et grátia apud Deum et hómines.
text.en: And Jesus advanced * in wisdom, and age, and grace with God and men.

text.la: Et dicébant: * Unde huic sapiéntia hæc, et virtútes? Nonne hic est fabri fílius?
text.en: And they said: * How came this man by this wisdom and miracles? Is not this the carpenter's son?

text.la: Descéndit Iesus cum María et Ioseph, et venit Názareth: et erat súbditus illis.
text.en: Jesus went down with Mary and Joseph, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them.

v.la: Ponam univérsos fílios tuos doctos a Dómino.
v.en: All thy children shall be taught of the Lord.

r.en: And great shall be the peace of thy children.

text.la: Illúmina nos, Dómine, * exémplis Famíliæ tuæ, et dírige pedes nostros in viam pacis.
text.en: Enlighten us, O Lord, * by the example of thy family, and direct our feet into the way of peace.

text.la: Dómine Iesu Christe, qui, Maríæ et Ioseph súbditus, domésticam vitam ineffabílibus virtútibus consecrásti: fac nos, utriúsque auxílio, Famíliæ sanctæ tuæ exémplis ínstrui; et consórtium cónsequi sempitérnum:
text.en: Lord Jesus Christ, who subject to Mary and Joseph, didst consecrate family life by thy unspeakable virtues, aid us by their united intercession to profit by the examples of thy Holy Family, and attain to their everlasting companionship:
